title: Live H1 dynamic compact columns
objective: Derive the compact-unit factor-column prefix from authenticated live HNF owner state and preserve the authentic h1 bridge across oversized answer-independent storage with mutation rejection.

oracles: Frozen authentic resident H1 owner graph

handoff.summary: The live H1 bridge no longer accepts an answer-shaped columns scalar. It derives the compact prefix from hnf_state[1], authenticates that count against the independent accepted-relation equation hnf_state[7] == prep_base_state[2] + hnf_state[1], and rejects inconsistent authority before touching result owners. The focused checker runs the frozen seven-column case in capacity-16 owners, proves unused tails remain untouched, and rejects all three independent dimension mutations in CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged execution.
risks: This narrow handoff intentionally ran focused Linux checks rather than the lane-wide baselib/native suites while integration compiles were active.
next_steps: Integrate the commit, then let the integration lane run its existing broad qualification and end-to-end replay.
